name: Mobile and electronics shop
blurb: Dues for phones, accessories and repairs
intro: If you sell phones and accessories, or do repairs, and sometimes accept payment later, BolCash helps you remember who still has to pay.

uses.title: Customer udhar
uses.body: Note amounts still due for a phone, an accessory or a repair.

uses.title: Supplier dues
uses.body: Keep track of what you owe your distributors, and note it when you pay.

uses.title: Daily cash
uses.body: Record the money that comes in and goes out each day.
